bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 163, Number 112 (Thursday, June 29, 2017)]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. BRENDAN F. BOYLE of Pennsylvania:
H.R. 3106.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The General Welfare Clause:
Article I, section 8 of the U.S. Constitution grants
Congress the power to ``lay and collect Taxes, Duties,
Imposts, and Excises, to pay the Debts and provide for the
common defense and general Welfare of the United States.''
[Page H5377]

bill.title: To amend the Safe Drinking Water Act to require the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency to publish a maximum contaminant level goal and promulgate a national primary drinking water regulation for perfluorinated compounds (including perfluorooctanesulfonic acid and perfluorooctanoic acid), and for other purposes.
